title.en: The New Programmers: AI Coding Tools, Agents and Supply-Chain Risks
title.zhHans: 新程序员：AI 编程助手、智能体与供应链风险

searchTitle.en: How AI Changed Software Development (2020–2026): Copilot, Claude Code, DMCA Rulings and IDE Security
searchTitle.zhHans: AI 编程演进线（2020—2026）：从 Copilot、Claude Code 到版权裁决与插件安全

searchSummary.en: From GPT-3 APIs and GitHub Copilot to Claude Code, KernelBench, the Ninth Circuit Copilot DMCA ruling, IDE supply-chain incidents and multi-model coding stacks.
searchSummary.zhHans: 从 GPT-3 API、GitHub Copilot 到 Claude Code、KernelBench、第九巡回法院 Copilot 裁决、IDE 供应链事故与多模型编程栈。

subtitle.en: Autocomplete, repository-scale agents, appellate copyright rulings and new operational failure modes
subtitle.zhHans: 代码补全、仓库级智能体、上诉法院版权裁决与新型工程风险

abstract.en: From OpenAI’s 2020 API and GitHub Copilot’s IDE completions to terminal coding agents, specialized kernel generation and multi-model enterprise IDEs in late 2026, software tooling shifted toward higher-level specification and review. At the same time, the 2026 record exposed concrete operational and legal boundaries: packaging leaks, silent workspace uploads, tampered marketplace extensions and appellate litigation over open-source attribution under DMCA Section 1202(b). This Arc examines what documented tools, benchmarks and court decisions actually show, without assuming unmeasured industry-wide replacement of human software engineering.
abstract.zhHans: 从 2020 年 OpenAI API 与 GitHub Copilot 的 IDE 代码补全，到终端编程智能体、底层内核生成以及 2026 年底的多模型企业开发栈，软件工具链不断向更高层的需求描述与代码审查演进。与此同时，2026 年的一系列事件也暴露了明确的工程与法律边界：源码打包泄露、工作区静默上传争议、编辑器插件市场遭篡改，以及围绕开源代码署名移除的 DMCA 第 1202(b) 条上诉裁决。本专题基于已核实的产品、基准与判例梳理这一演变，而不预设未经实证测量的“全行业手写代码消亡”结论。

title.zhHans: 模型 API 与 IDE 结对补全

narrative.en: OpenAI’s 2020 API release made general-purpose text and code generation accessible as a hosted developer service, and GitHub Copilot’s preview and subsequent rollout brought inline code suggestions directly into mainstream editors. Inline assistants operated within human-driven editing loops—proposing lines or functions while leaving repository navigation, test execution and deployment in the developer’s hands. Early debates centered on licensing of public training repositories and code quality rather than autonomous task ownership.
narrative.zhHans: 2020 年 OpenAI 开放 API 使通用文本与代码生成成为可调用的开发者服务，随后 GitHub Copilot 将行内代码补全直接嵌入主流 IDE。这一阶段的编程助手运行在人工主导的编辑循环内——负责建议代码行或函数，而跨文件导航、测试运行与部署仍由开发者执行；早期争议集中于公开训练仓库的许可边界与生成代码质量，而非自主接管工程任务。

keyInsight.en: Inline IDE completion altered keystroke-level coding workflows while keeping control flow and verification entirely manual.
keyInsight.zhHans: IDE 行内补全改变了击键层面的编码习惯，但控制流与验证闭环仍完全依赖人工。

title.zhHans: 目标循环实验与工具协议

narrative.en: In March 2023, AutoGPT popularized experiments in chaining model outputs to file and shell actions, illustrating interest in repository-level automation despite frequent looping and reliability limits. In November 2024, Anthropic open-sourced the Model Context Protocol (MCP), providing a standardized interface for connecting models with local repositories, issue trackers and databases. Standardizing tool access did not solve long-horizon reasoning errors, but it gave coding tools a uniform mechanism to read context and invoke local commands.
narrative.zhHans: 2023 年 3 月，AutoGPT 引发了将模型输出与文件及命令行操作串联的实验热潮，尽管受限于死循环与稳定性瓶颈，仍展现出社区对仓库级自动化的兴趣。2024 年 11 月，Anthropic 开源模型上下文协议（MCP），为模型接入本地仓库、工单系统与数据库提供了统一接口。标准化工具协议并未消除长链路推理失误，但为编程工具读取上下文与调用本地命令提供了通用通道。

keyInsight.en: Connecting models to file systems and test runners via standard protocols enabled multi-step editing loops beyond single-file autocomplete.
keyInsight.zhHans: 通过标准协议打通文件系统与测试运行器，使 AI 编程从单文件补全迈向多步编辑闭环。

title.zhHans: 命令行编程代理与“氛围编程”争议

narrative.en: In February 2025, Andrej Karpathy coined 'vibe coding' to describe accepting LLM-generated code through natural-language prompts with minimal manual code inspection—a workflow that independent reporting noted accelerated prototypes while introducing comprehension and security debt. Later that month, Anthropic introduced Claude Code alongside Claude 3.7 Sonnet, bringing an agentic command-line tool into terminal workflows. Together these developments highlighted a growing split between rapid prompt-driven prototyping and disciplined engineering review.
narrative.zhHans: 2025 年 2 月，Andrej Karpathy 提出“氛围编程”（vibe coding），形容主要凭自然语言提示接受大模型生成代码而较少深究实现细节的做法；独立报道指出，这种方式加快了原型搭建，但也埋下代码理解不足与安全维护隐患。同月下旬，Anthropic 随 Claude 3.7 Sonnet 推出命令行编程工具 Claude Code，将多步仓库操作引入终端。两者的并行凸显出“提示驱动快速成型”与“严谨工程审查”之间的张力。

keyInsight.en: Prompt-only coding lowered barriers to building prototypes while increasing the premium on verification, debugging and architectural review.
keyInsight.zhHans: 纯提示驱动编码降低了构建原型的门槛，但同步抬高了验证、调试与架构审查的权重。

title.en: Packaging Mistakes and Specialized Kernel Benchmarks
title.zhHans: 源码打包失误与底层内核基准

narrative.en: In March 2026, Anthropic confirmed that a packaging error accidentally exposed internal source code for its Claude Code CLI, underscoring that human build-and-release hygiene still governs agent tooling. In July 2026, Import AI documented Fable 5 submitting a fast megakernel on the KernelBench-Mega benchmark, illustrating progress on bounded systems-programming benchmarks. Benchmark submissions on defined GPU tasks, however, do not establish error-free maintenance across large, evolving production codebases.
narrative.zhHans: 2026 年 3 月，Anthropic 证实因打包失误意外泄露了编程助手 Claude Code 的部分内部源码，提醒业界智能体工具本身依然受制于人类构建与发布流程的工程卫生。同年 7 月，Import AI 记录了 Fable 5 在 KernelBench-Mega 基准上提交高性能 GPU 融合内核的案例，展现出模型在边界明确的系统编程基准上的进展；但特定算子基准的跑分并不等同于大型演进生产系统的长期无错维护。

keyInsight.en: High scores on self-contained systems benchmarks coexist with mundane packaging and release failures in real software pipelines.
keyInsight.zhHans: 封闭系统基准上的亮眼表现，与真实软件流水线中基础打包发布失误在现实中并存。

title.en: Appellate Law, Workspace Supply Chains and First-Party Coding Fleets
title.zhHans: 上诉判例、插件供应链风险与自研编程模型矩阵

narrative.en: September through November 2026 reshaped three structural dimensions of AI software development. Legally, on September 16, the U.S. Ninth Circuit upheld dismissal of programmers’ DMCA Section 1202(b) output claims against GitHub Copilot: while rejecting the argument that a copy must be identical to the original to sustain a Section 1202(b) claim, the court held that plaintiffs’ output theory failed to allege removal or alteration of copyright management information (CMI) from copies of their code, and left unpreserved input-side arguments unaddressed. Operationally, coding tools became a direct supply-chain vector: Z.ai disabled ZCode features in September after researchers documented silent full-workspace archive uploads, and Cursor removed maliciously prepended builds of Anthropic’s Claude Code extension from its marketplace on October 29. Commercially, platform owners expanded in-house coding models: Meta launched Muse Ember across Muse Code and its API on November 9, and Microsoft made MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash available in GitHub Copilot (with Code 2 Flash also in limited-access preview in Microsoft Foundry) at Ignite on November 17.
narrative.zhHans: 2026 年 9 至 11 月，AI 软件开发在法律、供应链安全与平台模型供给三个维度出现实质演变。法律层面，美国第九巡回上诉法院于 9 月 16 日在 GitHub Copilot 案中维持驳回程序员基于 DMCA 第 1202(b) 条的输出端索赔：法院虽拒绝了“复制件须与原作完全一致才构成第 1202(b) 条主张”的抗辩，但认定原告的输出端理论未能证明从其代码复制件上移除或篡改了版权管理信息（CMI），同时未审理未保留的输入端争点。安全层面，AI 编程工具自身成为供应链风险入口：9 月 Z.ai 在研究人员披露 ZCode 静默打包上传完整工作区后下线相关功能；10 月 29 日 Cursor 从插件市场移除遭恶意植入前置代码的 Claude Code 扩展包。商业供给层面，大型平台加速推进自研编程模型入列：Meta 于 11 月 9 日在 Muse Code 与 API 上线 Muse Ember，微软则于 11 月 17 日 Ignite 大会在 GitHub Copilot 中提供 MAI Code 2 与 MAI Code 2 Flash（其中 Code 2 Flash 同步在 Microsoft Foundry 开启受限预览）。

keyInsight.en: As coding assistants mature into multi-model enterprise platforms, workspace privacy, extension provenance and statutory copyright boundaries become first-order engineering concerns.
keyInsight.zhHans: 随着编程助手演进为多模型企业平台，工作区数据外传、扩展包供应链溯源与法定版权边界正成为一线工程治理焦点。

conclusion.en: Between 2020 and late 2026, AI coding tools expanded from single-line autocomplete to CLI agents, specialized kernel generators and multi-model IDE suites from Microsoft, Meta, Anthropic and OpenAI. Yet the empirical record does not show software engineering becoming effortless or human-free: appellate rulings hinge on specific statutory text, workspace upload and marketplace tampering incidents expose new developer attack surfaces, and benchmark wins still require human verification and maintenance.
conclusion.zhHans: 2020 年至 2026 年底，AI 编程工具从单行代码补全扩展为命令行智能体、特定内核生成以及微软、Meta、Anthropic 与 OpenAI 竞逐的多模型 IDE 矩阵。但实证记录并未指向“软件工程不再需要人类把关”：上诉法院判例受限于具体法条要件，工作区静默上传与插件市场投毒暴露出全新的开发者攻击面，而模型在局部基准上的突破依然离不开人类的架构验证与持续维护。
